description:
Otto must not treat its own status comments as trigger candidates. The authenticated GitHub user is still the only user allowed to trigger Otto; plain comments from that user should continue through trigger detection.

The unsafe loop comes from Otto-authored status replies, which are posted by the authenticated account and can therefore pass the author gate. Those comments must be rejected by the `otto:v1` status marker before trigger detection, for both issue comments and PR review comments.

Acceptance criteria:
- Comments from users other than the authenticated user are rejected.
- Plain comments from the authenticated user are kept.
- Comments containing the `otto:v1` status marker are rejected even when authored by the authenticated user.
- Polling tests cover issue and PR comment filtering paths so status comments cannot retrigger Otto.
title: Filter Otto status comments out of trigger detection
